entities.name: PINValidation
observations: Implements 4-digit PIN validation for device pairing
Uses Zod for schema validation
Includes rate limiting (5 attempts per 15 minutes)
Integrates with Wolf API for verification

entities.name: PINValidationService
observations: Located in src/lib/services/validation/pin.ts
Handles PIN format validation
Manages rate limiting logic
Provides error handling and logging
Uses in-memory Map for rate limiting storage
Implements resetAttempts method for successful validations
Throws typed PINValidationError for different error scenarios

entities.name: PairDialog
observations: Client-side component for device pairing
Implements real-time PIN validation
Uses ShadCN UI components
Handles error states and loading states
Implements real-time sanitization of PIN input
Uses font-mono and tracking-wider for better PIN readability
Integrates with custom useToast hook for notifications

entities.name: verifyPIN
observations: Server-side action for PIN verification
Integrates with Wolf API
Handles API responses and errors
Implements comprehensive logging
Handles three types of API responses: 200 success, 500 error, and unexpected
Resets rate limiting on successful validation
Uses environment variable WOLF_API_URL for API endpoint
